services.heading: Passport photos in Jetpur
services.description: Visit Rajmoti Studio in Jetpur for passport, visa and other ID photos. Tell us which application your photo is for so we can check the requested size and background.
services.question: What should I bring for a passport photo?
services.answer: Bring the photo instructions from the authority accepting your application, especially for visas or online forms. Tell us if you need printed photos, a digital file, or both.

services.heading: Old photo restoration in Jetpur
services.description: Bring an old, faded, scratched or damaged photograph to Rajmoti Studio in Jetpur. We assess the original and discuss how it can be restored and printed.
services.question: Can a blurry or damaged old photo be restored?
services.answer: It depends on the surviving detail. Bring the original or your clearest scan. We can assess fading, scratches and blur and explain what can be recovered while keeping the person’s likeness.

services.title: Gujarati Memorial Photo Frames in Jetpur | Rajmoti Studio
services.heading: Gujarati memorial photo frames in Jetpur

services.question: What do you need for a Gujarati memorial portrait?
services.answer: Bring the clearest photo you have, the person’s name in Gujarati, and any date or tithi you want included. Tell us your preferred frame size and verify the Gujarati text before printing.
